functions.name: CatalogBackupExternal
functions.plate_comment: Recovered from original Thumb bytes with exact EHABI start 0x3c5b4 and next start 0x3c5ec. Dereferences r1 as external-ID pointer, adds 2, calls 0x3c568 with a selected-native-flag output initialized to -1, and returns that selected output minus 2. The helper boolean is not the wrapper return. No external-ID bounds, file validity or cross-process completion inferred.
